//: The fancy-flow contracts the Flow bridge implements are whitelisted because
the integration is deliberately OPTIONAL: fancy-flow-php requires PHP 8.4 and
this package supports 8.2, so it lives under `suggest` and is never installed
as a dependency. Nothing autoloads src/Flow unless an application wires it.
Only the two interfaces are listed, not the FancyFlow namespace as a whole.
A prefix would let any future use of an uninstalled fancy-flow class pass this
check silently, which is the failure the checker exists to catch.
